title: HISTORICAL RECORD
theme: Legacy research notes challenge claims that shepherds or early Christmas history rule out a December birth of Jesus.
proposition: The notes argue that historical evidence does not establish that Jesus could not have been born on December 25.
sermonQuestion: Do the shepherds and early historical records establish that Jesus could not have been born on December 25?

legacyImport.contentPreservation: Original Josh Hetrick legacy sermon preserved unchanged.
